fields.description:
Intake deduplication currently records `intake_start` ledger rows with targets derived from the ticket content digest plus repository. ADP writes comments and status changes back to the ticket during a run. Those write-backs alter the digest. A later watermark poll sees a changed ticket revision, computes a different target, misses the completed ledger row, and starts a duplicate after the active execution reaches a terminal state.

The fix must keep the watermark path intact. Content changes still surface tickets to intake. The intake ledger must decide whether a surfaced ticket is a duplicate by stable ticket identity, while `inv intake --retry` remains the deliberate operator path because it clears the `intake_start` ledger row before the next surfaced change.

Identity-based keys fit the existing side-effect ledger without a schema change. The ledger compatibility lookup runs during `reserve()` for `intake_start` and checks completed rows by task id, operation, and the `:{repo}` target suffix before inserting the new key. That reserve-time lookup covers prior digest-based rows and rolling deployment overlap. `services/orchestration/intake_retry.py` clears repo-scoped rows by matching a `:{repo}` target suffix, so the new target keeps the `{ticket_id}:{repo}` shape.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Intake start ledger targets use ticket identity plus repository, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k intake_start_dedup_key_uses_ticket_identity_and_repo`
- [ ] Ticket write-back content changes after a terminal execution replay the completed intake record, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k ticket_writeback_change_after_terminal_execution_is_deduplicated`
- [ ] Operator-requested intake retry can admit the ticket after the ledger record is cleared, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k cleared_intake_dedup_allows_operator_requested_rerun`
- [ ] Prior digest-based intake ledger rows replay under the stable key during deployment, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_digest_based_intake_start_replays_for_the_same_ticket_repo`
- [ ] The rebar watermark poll still surfaces a never-run ticket when its status becomes admissible, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_rebar_intake_watermark.py -k ticket_that_becomes_admissible_later_is_still_seen`

## Testing
Run each acceptance criterion selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing the ticket.
